title: 第5章 智脑一号
content_zh:
刚进入梦乡的季枫听到这个仿佛电子合成一般的声音，顿时猛然一惊。他赶紧睁开眼，但是眼前的情景，却让他目瞪口呆。

“这这是在哪里？”季枫震惊的呢喃，在他的面前，是一片白茫茫的空间，除了一片白雾之外，便空无一物，天空中也是混沌一片，看不清楚任何东西。

“难道我是在做梦？”季枫嘀咕了一声。

谁知，他的话音刚落，之前那个淡漠的电子合成音就突然响了起来：“你没有做梦，我的主人！”

“谁？！”季枫吓了一跳，猛然转身四望，却依然没有看到任何东西，他不禁有些胆怯了：“是谁在说话？躲躲藏藏的算什么东西，有能耐出来！”

那个电子合成音突然再次响起，旋即，季枫前面的白雾发生了变化，快速的向中心汇聚，最终形成了一个拳头大小的白色光团，光芒很柔和，看起来十分的舒服。

只不过，季枫可没有舒服的感觉，在这光团上，有着一张仿佛孩童一般的小脸，小脸上的嘴张开，电子合成音就响了起来：“主人，很高兴见到你！”

季枫瞪大了眼睛，既震惊又疑惑的看着这个光团，半晌后才反应过来，迟疑的问道：“你，你是在跟我说话？”

“是的，主人！”光团晃动了几下，看起来就好像是在点头。

季枫强自镇定下来，又问道：“你……叫我主人？”

季枫觉得怪异极了，他摇头道：“你为什么要叫我主人？我们之前见过吗？”

季枫几乎要抓狂了，无缘无故来到这个空无一物的地方，又遇到这么一个长着孩童脸蛋的光团，他既害怕又疑惑。

“你到底是谁？”季枫无奈的问道。

“回主人，我是智脑一号，来自伽马星系的十三级文明国度，伽马帝国。”光团利索的回答道。

“你来自伽马星系？哈……”季枫相信自己真的是在做梦了，什么伽马星系，他从来都没有听说过，况且，更没有听说过什么十三级文明，什么伽马帝国！

这些东西，也只是在小说和电影中才能出现。

“看来，自己真的是摔坏了脑袋，不然的话，又怎么会突然有过目不忘的本事，又怎么会梦到这些稀奇古怪的东西？”季枫不禁有些担心了，自己摔着了脑袋，哪里有钱去看医生？

“是的，主人，智脑一号的确是来自伽马星系……”那光团显得十分的人性化，似乎看出了季枫的疑惑，立刻解释起来，“主人，伽马星系距离现在的这颗名叫地球的星球，大约有十亿光年！”

“好吧，伽马星系！”季枫无奈的点点头，既然无法从这种怪梦中醒来，那就继续做下去吧。

“智脑一号已经与主人彻底的融合完毕，请问主人何时开始训练？”光团突然问道。

季枫怔怔的看着光团，疑惑的问道：“什么训练？”

“天哪！天哪！”季枫忍不住抱头蹲下，使劲扯着自己的头发，“这究竟是怎么回事啊？”

季枫彻底被它的穷追不舍给打败了，无所谓的点头道：“算是吧，如果你能回答我，那更好！”

“当然可以，主人！”光团立刻说道，“按照地球上的时间来计算，事情应该是起源于三百年以前……”

季枫刚开始还只是无奈的抓狂，可是随着光团的叙说，他的注意力逐渐被吸引了过去，直到最后的无比震惊。

原来，这光团名叫智脑一号，是一个人工智能生命，来自伽马星系的十三级文明国度伽马帝国。同时，智脑一号也是一套超级特工训练系统！

在伽马星系有着很多国度，每一个都有着极其发达的科技，而且已经进入了星际时代！但是，科技的发达，却无法阻止人性的贪婪。每一个国家都想吞并其他的国家，称霸宇宙。

为了战争，每一个国度都尽心研究武器，伽马帝国作为星系中最强大的国家，则更加重视战争情报，因此十分重视对特工间谍的培养。

智脑一号，就是一套在战争时期被制造出来的人工智能，专门负责训练超级特工！

伽马星系的战争进行了三百年，最终，星系中最大的一颗恒星被超强的战争能量给毁灭了。恒星的爆发，瞬间让整个星系的其他恒星全部引爆，整个伽马星系就像是诺米骨牌一样，在短短的几天之内就彻底的毁灭了。

智脑一号在这场星系毁灭的大灾难中，被一缕伽马射线电子束给带了出来，经过三百年的漫长宇宙旅行，最终降落在了地球上，进入了季枫的身体里！

听完，季枫呆呆的问道：“你是说，我现在……在我的身体里？”

“是的，主人！”光团，不，应该是智脑一号，点头说道：“准确的说，是在主人的脑海之中！”

“你确定我不是在做梦？”季枫忍不住又问了一句。实际上，他心里已经有七八分相信了。

虽然之前忽略了，但是现在回忆起来，三天前，他在街上似乎隐约听到过新闻播报，其中就有关于伽马射线耀斑的新闻。

再加上他出院之后身体没有任何的不舒服，反而感觉充满了力量，甚至还有了过目不忘的本事。

这一切的变化，都在证明智脑一号并没有说谎。

“是的主人，你没有在做梦！”智脑一号说道。

季枫忍不住讪笑两声，为自己的胆小和迟疑感到尴尬。

“请问主人，是否立刻开始训练？”智脑一号开口问道。

季枫一怔，这才想起，智脑一号是一个智能生命，功能就是负责将人训练成超级特工。

他疑惑的问道：“智脑一号，我也能训练吗？”

因为营养跟不上，所以季枫从小就身体孱弱，想变成传说中那些身手矫健的特工，恐怕只能是白日做梦。

“主人，你完全可以接受训练，虽然你的身体情况尚未达到最低训练标准，但是等主人学会了健体操之后，就可以正式训练了！”智脑一号回答道：“而且，在正式进行体能与暴力训练之前，主人可以先学习其他的知识！”

“其他的知识？”季枫好奇的问，“什么知识？”

“一个优秀的特工，不但要有超强的身手，同时也要精通多种语言，学会伪装，懂得各种礼仪，精通各种武器，以及其他各种技能……”智脑一号的语气变得严肃起来，就好像一个黑面教官一般，“这其中，有很多知识是对身体情况没有要求的！”

季枫恍然，不禁问道：“你刚才说的最低训练标准，是什么？”

智脑一号立刻说道：“根据人类的身体情况，一共分为十三级，从三级开始，可以正式接受特工系统的训练！”

季枫明白了，又问：“那我现在的身体情况，属于几级？”

智脑一号说道：“主人现在的身体增强三倍，就可以达到一级！”
content_en:
Ji Feng, who had just fallen asleep, was suddenly startled when he heard this electronically synthesized sound.He quickly opened his eyes, but the scene in front of him stunned him.

"Where is this?" Ji Feng murmured in shock. In front of him was a vast white space. Except for a white mist, there was nothing. The sky was also chaotic and he couldn't see anything clearly.

"Am I dreaming?" Ji Feng muttered.

Unexpectedly, as soon as he finished speaking, the indifferent electronic synthesized voice suddenly sounded: "You are not dreaming, my master!"

"Who?!" Ji Feng was startled. He suddenly turned around and looked around, but still didn't see anything. He couldn't help but feel a little timid: "Who is talking? What's the point of hiding? Come out if you have the ability!"

The electronic synthesized sound suddenly sounded again, and immediately, the white mist in front of Ji Feng changed, quickly converging toward the center, and finally formed a white light group the size of a fist. The light was very soft and looked very comfortable.

However, Ji Feng did not feel comfortable. On this light group, there was a small face like a child. The mouth on the small face opened, and an electronic synthesized voice sounded: "Master, I am glad to see you!"

Ji Feng's eyes widened, looking at the light group in shock and confusion. After a while, he realized what he was doing and asked hesitantly: "You, are you talking to me?"

"Yes, Master!" The light ball shook a few times, as if it was nodding.

Ji Feng calmed down and asked again: "You... call me master?"

Ji Feng felt extremely weird. He shook his head and said, "Why do you call me master? Have we met before?"

Ji Feng almost went crazy. He came to this empty place for no reason and encountered such a light ball with a child's face. He was scared and confused.

"Who are you?" Ji Feng asked helplessly.

"Master, I am Zhinao No. 1, a level 13 civilization from the Gamma Galaxy, the Gamma Empire." Guang Tuan replied neatly.

"Are you from the Gamma Galaxy? Ha..." Ji Feng believed that he was really dreaming. He had never heard of the Gamma Galaxy. Moreover, he had never heard of any level 13 civilization or the Gamma Empire!

These things can only appear in novels and movies.

"It seems that I really broke my head. Otherwise, how could I suddenly have a photographic memory and dream about these weird things?" Ji Feng couldn't help but worry a little. He broke his head. How could he have the money to see a doctor?

"Yes, Master, Zhi Nao No. 1 does come from the Gamma Galaxy..." The light group seemed very humane. It seemed that he saw Ji Feng's doubts and immediately explained, "Master, the Gamma Galaxy is about one billion light years away from the current planet called Earth!"

"Okay, Gamma Galaxy!" Ji Feng nodded helplessly. Since he couldn't wake up from this strange dream, he should continue to do it.

"Zhi Nao No. 1 has been completely integrated with the master. When will the master start training?" Guangtuan suddenly asked.

Ji Feng looked at the light group blankly and asked doubtfully: "What kind of training?"

"Oh my God! Oh my God!" Ji Feng couldn't help but squat down with his head in his hands, pulling his hair hard, "What on earth is going on?"

Ji Feng was completely defeated by its relentless pursuit. He nodded indifferently and said, "That's right. If you can answer me, that would be even better!"

"Of course, Master!" Guang Tuan said immediately, "According to the time on earth, the matter should have originated three hundred years ago..."

Ji Feng was just helpless and crazy at first, but as Guang Tuan narrated, his attention was gradually attracted, until he was extremely shocked at the end.

It turns out that this light group is called Zhinao No. 1, and it is an artificial intelligence life form from the Gamma Empire, a level 13 civilization in the Gamma Galaxy.At the same time, Zhinao No. 1 is also a super agent training system!

There are many countries in the Gamma Galaxy, each of which has extremely advanced technology and has entered the interstellar age!However, the development of science and technology cannot stop the greed of human nature.Every country wants to annex other countries and dominate the universe.

For the sake of war, every country is dedicated to researching weapons. As the most powerful country in the galaxy, the Gamma Empire pays more attention to war intelligence and therefore attaches great importance to the training of agents and spies.

Zhi Nao No. 1 is a set of artificial intelligence created during the war, specifically responsible for training super agents!

The war in the Gamma Galaxy lasted for three hundred years. In the end, the largest star in the galaxy was destroyed by the super war energy.The explosion of the star instantly caused all the other stars in the entire galaxy to explode. The entire Gamma Galaxy was like a domino, completely destroyed in just a few days.

Zhinao-1 was brought out by a gamma ray electron beam in the catastrophe of galaxy destruction. After three hundred years of long space travel, it finally landed on the earth and entered Ji Feng's body!

After listening, Ji Feng asked blankly: "You mean, I am...in my body now?"

"Yes, Master!" The light group, no, it should be Zhi Nao No. 1, nodded and said: "To be precise, it is in the master's mind!"

"Are you sure I'm not dreaming?" Ji Feng couldn't help but ask again.In fact, he already believed it in his heart.

Although he had ignored it before, he now recalled that he seemed to have vaguely heard the news broadcast on the street three days ago, including news about gamma ray flares.

In addition, he did not feel any physical discomfort after being discharged from the hospital. Instead, he felt full of strength and even had a photographic memory.

All these changes prove that Zhinao No. 1 is not lying.

"Yes, Master, you are not dreaming!" Zhinao No. 1 said.

Ji Feng couldn't help but laugh twice, feeling embarrassed for his timidity and hesitation.

"Master, would you like to start training immediately?" Zhi Nao No. 1 asked.

Ji Feng was startled, and then he remembered that Zhinao No. 1 was an intelligent being whose function was to train people to become super agents.

He asked doubtfully: "Zhi Nao No. 1, can I also train?"

Because of poor nutrition, Ji Feng has been weak since he was a child. If he wants to become one of the legendary and powerful agents, he may only be a daydream.

"Master, you are completely able to accept training. Although your physical condition has not yet reached the minimum training standard, you can start formal training after master learns gymnastics!" Zhinao No. 1 replied: "Moreover, before formal physical and violent training, master can learn other knowledge first!"

"Other knowledge?" Ji Feng asked curiously, "What knowledge?"

"An excellent agent must not only have super skills, but also be proficient in multiple languages, learn disguises, understand various etiquettes, be proficient in various weapons, and other skills..." Zhinao No. 1's tone became serious, like a black-faced instructor. "A lot of this knowledge does not require physical conditions!"

Ji Feng was stunned and couldn't help but ask: "What is the minimum training standard you just mentioned?"

Zhinao No. 1 immediately said: "Based on human body conditions, there are a total of thirteen levels. Starting from level three, you can officially receive training in the agent system!"

Ji Feng understood and asked: "What level does my current physical condition belong to?"

Zhinao No. 1 said: "The master's current body is three times stronger, and he can reach the first level!"
